detail: Findmypast, searched while signed in on 16 October 2026: Hertfordshire Baptisms (surname-only, county-wide), Hertfordshire Burials, and the 1841 and 1851 censuses at Aldenham. The surname-only passes that the 13 October session could not repeat are now done.

236 entries (some twice) across 22 places, Tring, Aldbury and Bovingdon the largest. The Marys among them were baptised in 1723 and 1737, then not again until 1857 (Mary Elizabeth) and 1864 (Mary Ann). NO MARY WAS BAPTISED BURCH IN THE COUNTY BETWEEN 1738 AND 1856. The name-variants option did not bring in Birch. Aldenham holds 7 Burch baptisms, none before 1811.

Berkhamsted 1765 (Daniel and Mary); Abbots Langley 1773 (William); Northchurch 1781 (Jonathan and Agnes); Abbots Langley 1782 (Adam); Wigginton 1783 (Jno); Watford, born 27 December 1782 (Chas and Mary); St Albans Abbey 1783 (Mary Ann; Thomas and Elizabeth); Abbots Langley, born 26 August 1784 (John); Bovingdon, born 26 August 1791 (James and Rebecca). None is chosen.

24 entries: Aldenham, John and Hannah 1740 to 1749; Aldenham, William and Ann 1809 to 1828; Aldenham, William and Sarah 1848 to 1864; Rickmansworth 1856; Watford 1871; North Mimms 1893. NO MARY BEFORE 1851 AT ALL.
The set stops about 1810: the last Hawkins burial at Aldenham in it is 1808 and the last Larkin is 1810, though the baptism set runs past 1860. A burial missing from it after 1810 is not a finding.

record: The register's children of 'Robert and Mary Larkin'
detail: Aldenham baptisms, father a labourer in every one. Sarah, born 30 March 1814 (banns were called on 16 January 1814); Mary, born 8 September 1815; Elizabeth, 1818; Joseph, born 4 May 1820; Robert William, born 4 June 1821; EMMA, BORN 3 MARCH 1822; Amy 1823; James, born 29 April 1824; John and a second Joseph, both baptised 23 November 1828; Thomas, baptised 31 March 1833.

EMMA WAS BORN 272 DAYS AFTER ROBERT WILLIAM. They cannot share a mother. Robert William is the Robert aged 30 in the household of the widow Mary born at Edgware about 1800, who would have been 21 at his birth, and Joseph (second), Eliza and Thomas fit the same household. The other couple is the pair of 1851 household one, born at Aldenham about 1779 and 1782, whose daughters Mary and Elizabeth match the baptisms of 1815 and 1818 in name and, within about three years, in age. That couple is the banns couple of 1814, and the only Robert-and-Mary marriage in the Aldenham register. The earlier note on this site that the eleven children were one family, 'two Josephs, so the first had died', is withdrawn.

1851: 23 Hawkinses; none is a Mary born before 1790. 1841: 20 Hawkinses; the only William old enough to have married in 1800 is William, 65, at Round Bush (HO107 piece 438 book 3 folio 10 page 14, schedule 477), in a household of Mash and Rogers, with no wife. NO MARY HAWKINS OF HER AGE IS INDEXED AT ALDENHAM IN EITHER CENSUS. That does not say when Mary Appleyard died.

record: Marriage entry, Robert Larkin and Mary Burch
detail: Hertfordshire Banns & Marriages, Aldenham: married by banns on 6 February 1814, both of the parish of Aldenham, groom a bachelor, bride a spinster, witnesses Wm Larkins and Wm Nicholls. The bride's surname is transcribed BARCH in the marriage entry and Burch in the banns entry of 16 January 1814. Sarah, their first child on the register, was born 30 March 1814, 52 days after the wedding.

32 Larkin burials in the county, 21 of them at Aldenham, each with an age and abode. Robert, 12 March 1826, aged 77, Alms Houses. Robert, 16 September 1832, aged 45, the Folly. Mary, 14 October 1855, aged 72, Round Bush. Robert, 20 February 1859, aged 79, Round Bush Alms Houses. Mary, 29 February 1860, aged 62, Letchmore Heath.

record: What the burials and censuses say together
detail: Robert of 1859 (79) and Mary of 1855 (72) fit the couple of the 1851 household at Round Bush, Robert 72 and Mary 69. Mary of 1860 (62) at Letchmore Heath fits the widow born at Edgware about 1800, who is in the 1851 household at Letchmore Heath and is in no later census. Robert of 1832 (45) fits her husband, and Thomas, baptised on 31 March 1833, would have been born after his death. Robert of 1826 (77) is a third and older man, born about 1749. All of these are matched by name, age and abode and none is tied by a document.
7 people. None is a Robert of about 80, a Mary of about 78 or a Mary of about 61: all three had died or left. The Mary born 1811 and William born 1819 are another household.

record: Burch and Barch families at Aldenham
detail: Baptisms from 1810: John and Ann (James, entered as BARCH, 1810; Joseph 1821; Reuben 1823; Phyllis 1827; William 1828); John and Sarah (Jonathan 1811); William and Mary (James 1822); Joseph and Jane (John 1824). None before 1810. A Burch family was therefore in the parish by 1810, and the earlier generation is not in its registers.

record: Birch and Burch at Watford, St Mary
detail: Charles and Rebecca Birch baptised Charlotte 1770, Ann 1776 and Charles 1781. Charles and Mary baptised Mary (born 27 December 1782, entered BIRCH) and Trothy in 1784 (entered BURCH). So one Watford family is written both ways in one register. Mary of 27 December 1782 would have been 72 on 14 October 1855, the age at which a Mary Larkin was buried at Round Bush, and 68 at the 1851 census, which says 69. Abbots Langley, 13 January 1782 (Adam), fits the census and is a year out on the burial. Neither is chosen.

A marriage of a Robert Larkin to a Mary at any place in Hertfordshire between 1818 and 1822, or in Middlesex between 1817 and 1823, in Findmypast's indexes. Her husband's marriage is therefore not found; that is not a finding, because the Edgware registers are not in those sets.

Hertfordshire Banns & Marriages, Aldenham: banns on 22 October 1843 for William Bilby and Mary Larkin, both of Aldenham; the marriage is registered in the December quarter of 1843 at Watford. Neither entry names a father.

Mary, daughter of William, a labourer, and Mary Bilby, baptised at Aldenham on 7 July 1844. William Bilby buried at Aldenham on 8 October 1844, aged 29 (National Burial Index, Hertfordshire Family & Population History Society). A Mary Bilby marries in 1867 at Watford (registration index): the granddaughter of the 1851 household.

The 1851 household names Mary Bilby, a widow of 33, as the daughter of Robert and Mary Larkin. She is the Mary Larkin who married William Bilby in 1843 and was widowed a year later; her age of 33 is two or three years under the baptism of 8 September 1815, as Elizabeth's is. The marriage does not name her father, so the link to the 1814 couple still rests on the 1851 relationship column.

Hertfordshire Banns & Marriages: WILLIAM HAWKINS and MARY APPLEYARD married at Aldenham on 5 May 1800, both of the parish (banns 20 April 1800). The surname is written Appleyard in the marriage entry as in the banns.

Mary, daughter of William and Mary Hawkins, 24 April 1820, aged 7, near the Church. MARY, WIFE OF WILLIAM HAWKINS, 30 JANUARY 1822, AGED 41, Aldenham Gate. William Hawkins, 23 November 1848, aged 76, Aldenham near the Church. The wife of 1822 was born about 1780 or 1781; the entry names her husband William and does not name her maiden name.

record: What that does to the Birch candidates
detail: A Mary Birch aged 16 was buried at Abbots Langley in May 1796: she may be the girl baptised there on 13 January 1782, in which case she was 14 and her entry is two years out. A Mary Birch married James Beech at Watford in February 1804: she may be the Watford girl of 27 December 1782, aged 21. Either would exclude the candidate. Neither is proved, and neither candidate is now more than a name on a list.
